body: a stylized chibi 3D-render character: a supreme royal knight-king, standing in a strict SCARECROW T-POSE facing the camera dead-on, BOTH ARMS LOCKED COMPLETELY STRAIGHT OUT HORIZONTALLY TO THE SIDES at exactly shoulder height (NOT bent, NOT hanging down toward the hips, elbows perfectly straight, each arm forming one continuous straight horizontal line from shoulder to fingertip), both open empty hands and all fingers clearly visible in empty air with a large gap between each hand and the body, nothing held, legs straight shoulder-width apart, nothing overlapping the torso or limbs. Matte black plate armor with rich gold trim. UNMISTAKABLY CROWNED: a tall, ornate, jewel-tipped gold crown with at least 5 visible spikes worn directly on top of the head, dominant silhouette feature. A black domino half-mask instead of a full helm so the crown reads clearly. Large black-feathered angel wings mounted on the back, folded flat against the back (not spread, so they don't interfere with the arm silhouette), spanning wider than the shoulders. A gold ornamental scepter strapped diagonally across the back (not in either hand). A short black-and-gold cape ending above the knee, short and stiff. Toy-like chibi proportions, big head small stocky body, smooth 3D render style, single even studio lighting, plain flat white background, full body head to feet, no text, no logos
